entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-21
entry.content:

  • Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer 10.0.11 refers Microsoft.Data.SqlClient >= 6.1.6 but at runtime needs 7.0.0.0 #38845
  • Set operation over a projection containing a null-checked to-one non-entity subquery no longer translates (11 preview.7 regression) #38838
    11.0.0
  • Named default constraint removal incorrectly targets temporal history table #38836
    12.0.0
